name: clicky-win
description: Clicky for Windows — an AI companion that lives next to your cursor, sees your screen, talks to you, and points at things.

scripts.build: npm run generate-icons && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && npm run build:audio && npm run copy-static
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.audio.json
